cleanerSmarter.heading: We are one of the UK’s leading providers of secure and confidential shredding services. With years of experience in the industry, we have built an extensive customer base spanning all industries, public sectors, and sizes of businesses across the country.
paragraphs: We offer recycling and shredding for paper, plastics, textiles and digital media in highly secure environments so that you meet your data protection compliance requirements and can rest easy knowing that you are preventing fraud, identity and intellectual property theft with trusted experts.
We have a breadth of knowledge and experience in the secure destruction of confidential waste. Our team is friendly, knowledgeable, and always looking for ways to help you.

metaDescription: TechSteps is an IT asset recovery and responsible recycling company. We partner with businesses to securely manage their retired technology.

nationwideNetwork.description: Restore Datashred boasts a robust network spanning the entire UK. With strategically located facilities, we ensure efficient and timely service, no matter where your business is located. With our local reach, we can tailor a service plan to perfectly suit your volume and frequency of document shredding, while our national presence guarantees the security and compliance expertise you expect for any data disposal needs, from paper shredding to hard drive destruction.
nationwideNetwork.heading: Nationwide network, local expertise
nationwideNetwork.imageAlt: Hand holding recovered IT components and hardware

sustainabilityCommitment.description: Restore Datashred isn’t just about secure data destruction; we’re also passionate about protecting the environment. As a leading recycling business, we’re proud to work towards being Net Zero from our shredding activities by 2035 – a commitment our customers truly value. Furthermore, we are fully authorised by the Environment Agency to handle, transport, and recycle your company’s confidential materials. Choose Restore Datashred for peace of mind on both data security and environmental responsibility.
